name: How long does a bathroom addition project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom addition project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom addition project depends on its complexity and scale. A small, straightforward half-bath addition in an accessible area might take 4-6 weeks from demolition to final inspection. A full-sized bathroom, especially one requiring significant structural changes, new plumbing runs, or high-end custom finishes, can take 8-12 weeks or more. Factors like permit acquisition, material availability, and the coordination of specialized trades also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, outlining key milestones and estimated completion dates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom additions can take 4-12 weeks or longer, depending on complexity, size, and custom finishes. We provide a detailed project schedule for clarity.
